name: 3t-edu-tech-workspace
description: Root workspace to manage all services

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix 3t-edu-tech-backend && npm install --prefix edu-ai-learning-hub && cd ai-service && uv sync
scripts.dev:docker: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d redis database database-init
scripts.dev:ai: cd ai-service && uv run uvicorn src.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 2111 --reload
scripts.dev: npm run dev:docker && concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,AI" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:ai"
